issues.description: Duplicate "transcriber_error" entry in the error message_type tuple
issues.detail: The tuple lists "transcriber_error" twice. Harmless at runtime but signals the diff wasn't reread. Lift the known error types to a module-level frozenset (or mapping) so duplicates are impossible and additions are data, not code edits.

issues.description: Loss of per-type context in pushed errors and dropped logger.error call
issues.detail: Old code prefixed "Auth error:" / "Quota exceeded:" and emitted logger.error per type. The collapsed branch pushes only "Error: <error>" and drops the log line, so auth_error is indistinguishable from rate_limited downstream. Include message_type in the pushed error and restore an operator-visible log.

issues.description: Removing the outer try/except changes _receive_messages' termination contract without naming it
issues.detail: The infinite-loop fix works by letting websocket exceptions propagate so the outer reconnect loop sees disconnects, but nothing documents that contract. Connection-lifecycle and per-message parsing are now complected implicitly. Add a comment stating the invariant, or make disconnect an explicit return/signal rather than an unnamed exception bubble.

issues.description: Inner per-message handler still catches bare Exception, masking real bugs
issues.detail: The per-message try/except logs and continues on any Exception, so KeyError or AttributeError in _process_response is indistinguishable from a malformed frame and won't trigger reconnect. Narrow the except to json.JSONDecodeError plus a documented set, or re-raise unexpected types so the reconnect path can act.

issues.description: Bundled bugfix, rename, and error-type expansion in one PR
issues.detail: The diff combines the infinite-loop fix, a silent rename of _process_messages to _receive_messages, and the error-type expansion. These are separable concerns; bundling them makes bisect harder and the changelog opaque. Split into focused PRs or at minimum call out the rename in the changelog.
changelog/3233.fixed.md ends without a newline. Minor, but POSIX text-file conventions and most lint tooling expect one, and it produces noisy diffs later. Trivial fix.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the core fix is directionally right: removing the swallowing outer try/except lets websocket disconnects propagate to the reconnect loop, and collapsing three near-identical elif branches into a membership test is good shape. But the diff ships with a duplicate "transcriber_error" entry, loses per-type context and the logger.error line so auth vs quota errors look the same downstream, and silently changes _receive_messages' termination contract without naming it. Lift the error types to module-level data, preserve message_type in pushed errors, document the loop invariant, and unbundle the rename. NEEDS-WORK before landing.
